integration_issues.flow: Practice / Session write phase / Archive transcribe (Skia drawing on web)
integration_issues.issue: canvaskit.wasm fails to load on web preview with 'Failed to execute compile on WebAssembly: Incorrect response MIME type. Expected application/wasm.' followed by 'WebAssembly.instantiate(): expected magic word 00 61 73 6d, found 3c 21 44 4f' — the server is returning HTML (likely the SPA fallback) instead of the .wasm binary. SkiaGate catches this and shows the graceful 'THE CANVAS IS UNAVAILABLE HERE' fallback, so the app no longer crashes. Drawing/save/transcribe must be validated on Expo Go (native) where Skia uses JNI and does not need canvaskit-wasm. To enable web Skia drawing, the deployment ingress/static server needs a MIME type rule for *.wasm OR canvaskit.wasm needs to be copied into web-build/ assets at build time (npx expo export then serve canvaskit.wasm with correct mime).

react_native_issues.component: Collections cards / Archive cards / Category chips
react_native_issues.issue: Collections content cards, archive doc cards, and category chips render visually with correct data (e.g., 'Marcus Aurelius · 180 AD', 'Diary, October 1872', chips: All/Affirmations/Creativity/Gratitude/...) but did not match selectors [data-testid^='content-card-'], [data-testid^='archive-card-'], or [data-testid^='chip-']. Cards may use different testID naming conventions (e.g., piece-{id}, archive-{id}, category-{name}) or omit testIDs entirely. Recommend standardizing on content-card-{id}, archive-card-{id}, chip-{category} so automated tap-to-open-session and tap-to-open-archive flows can be exercised reliably.
Repeated 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), 'useNativeDriver fallback to JS animation'. None affect functionality.

rca_of_issue: Previous iteration RCA (AsyncStorage web hang + Skia crash) is now mitigated. (1) AsyncStorage hang: storage.ts now branches on Platform.OS — web path uses synchronous window.localStorage wrapped in async functions, so storage.hasOnboarded() resolves immediately and index.tsx splash can redirect to /onboarding. Verified with playwright: redirect happens within 15s. (2) Skia crash: HandwritingCanvas is now mounted via SkiaGate, which dynamic-imports CanvasKit on web and shows a fallback if loadSkiaWeb() rejects. Web preview's WebAssembly compile fails with 'Incorrect response MIME type' because the kubernetes ingress serves /static/canvaskit.wasm as HTML SPA fallback (404 fallback) — the .wasm file is not in the deployed bundle. SkiaGate catches the rejection and renders the 'CANVAS UNAVAILABLE' card. On native (Expo Go) the canvaskit-wasm path is not used (Skia is JNI), so drawing works. To unblock web Skia drawing in future: ship canvaskit.wasm in expo web-build assets and add a MIME mapping in the ingress.
